def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    for c in range(w):
        if grid[h-1][c] != 5: continue
        pts=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        if not pts: continue
        top=pts[0]
        for r in range(top): out[r][c]=grid[top][c]
        for upper,lower in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
            color=grid[lower][c]
            for r in range(upper+1,lower): out[r][c]=color
    return out

program_text='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend vertical tracks above bottom-row 5 markers.

    Existing colored cells act as landmarks. Above the top landmark, extend
    its color to the top edge. Between landmarks, use the color of the lower
    landmark; the landmarks themselves remain unchanged.
    """
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0]) if height else 0
    if not height:
        return out
    for col in range(width):
        if grid[height - 1][col] != 5:
            continue
        landmarks = [r for r in range(height) if grid[r][col] != 0]
        if not landmarks:
            continue
        top = landmarks[0]
        for r in range(top):
            out[r][col] = grid[top][col]
        for upper, lower in zip(landmarks, landmarks[1:]):
            color = grid[lower][col]
            for r in range(upper + 1, lower):
                out[r][col] = color
    return out
'''
